text: Baga beach road completely waterlogged, shacks closed, avoid this week
Water sports cancelled at Calangute, rough sea and red flag up
Scuba trip to Grande Island cancelled, zero visibility, got a refund after 2 hours
Dudhsagar jeep safari closed by forest department after heavy rain
Flood alert in North Goa low lying areas, traffic jam everywhere
Rainy Panjim but the cooking class and seafood places are open and cozy
Palolem quieter than usual, sea still rough, no swimming allowed
Hotel prices in Candolim doubled this weekend because of a festival, ridiculous
Om Beach sunny and calm today, kayaking open, barely any crowd
Netrani snorkelling was amazing, clear water and turtles
Beach trek from Kudle was beautiful, light drizzle only
Water crystal clear at Grande Island, scuba was unreal
Palolem sunset was beautiful, calm sea, great shacks
Parasailing at Calangute open, sunny and great fun
Baga packed with crowds tonight, go south if you want quiet
Dudhsagar falls in full flow, jeep safari open, amazing views
Cooking class in Panjim was the highlight of our trip
Om Beach calm and clean, great for kayaking
